title: Paperless Referrer Bonus on Residential Electricity Supply Referral Credits
content:
Residential Electricity Supply referral credits carry a paperless bonus based on the referring agreement.

**Rule.** When the referring agreement was enrolled through the web and at least one notice on it was delivered by email, the full referral paperless bonus of 5.00 USD is added; when exactly one of those two holds, the partial referral paperless bonus of 3.00 USD is added; when neither holds, nothing is added.

| Referring agreement enrolled through the web | At least one notice on it delivered by email | Referral paperless bonus |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 5.00 USD |
| yes | no | 3.00 USD |
| no | yes | 3.00 USD |
| no | no | nothing |

**Records read.** The enrollment channel of the referring agreement and the delivery channel of the notices recorded on that agreement. The referred customer's own enrollment channel plays no part.

**Example (hypothetical).** A referrer who enrolled by phone and has received one rate change notice by email adds 3.00 USD.
